thread:
Rina (PM): quick thought: new small change for org invite UI — show an SSO prompt card instead of a disabled email field for SSO-only orgs. also propose an 'Activity' shortcut next to each role that jumps to audit. figma: https://figma.redwood/sso-prompt-shortcuts 

Omar (UX): agree on replacing the disabled field. i'd label the card: 'Invites managed by your organization's SSO' with primary CTA 'Copy join link' + subtle 'Manage SSO' link. include tiny TTL hint like 'Expires: 7 days' (optional). keep wording friendly.

Kai (Frontend): ok to implement. client checks org.sso_required -> render SSO card. must announce the replacement via `aria-live="polite"`. Activity shortcut should call `scrollIntoView` and then focus the target anchor: 
```
const target = document.getElementById(`audit-${roleId}`);
if (target) { target.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); target.focus(); }
```
Fallback: open audit in new tab if audit pane not loaded.

June (Accessibility): a11y notes: 
- announce card replacement and ensure it is a `role=region` with `aria-label`.
- make Activity a real `button` with `aria-controls` pointing to the audit list.
- after focusing anchor, remove `tabindex` when focus leaves (avoid trapping).
- color contrast check for card text must meet 4.5:1.

ux-lint-bot: checklist: aria-live present, Activity is button, anchor ids stable, telemetry keys: `invite.method`, `invite.link.copied`, `audit.jump.source=role_shortcut`.

Rina (PM): nice. action: Omar -> update copy + compact layout; Kai -> implement focus/scroll + aria-live; June -> add a11y test cases. i'll create tickets and tag folks. thanks! :sparkles:
